name: Naya
source: Naya is the Alpha werewolf of the Blue Moon Pack. Due to a dark prophecy foretold about her, many of the pack have issues trusting her. Her raw strength is rivalled by few and she can easily fight wolves whilst still in her human form. Despite this, she is very innocent and playful when she lets down her guard and wishes happiness to everyone. Her duties rarely give her time to do so, but when free, she loves to bake.
